mapper.sql: P.ID, P.CLASS_ID, P.URL, P.CAPTION, P.THEME, P.AUTHOR, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(P.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, (SELECT U.NAME FROM T_USER U WHERE U.ID = P.AUTHOR) AUTHOR_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_PHOTO P WHERE P.CLASS_ID = #{classId} ORDER BY P.ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_PHOTO(CLASS_ID, URL, CAPTION, THEME, AUTHOR) VALUES (#{classId}, #{url}, #{caption}, #{theme}, #{author})
